(()=>{if(document.querySelector('.bazett-panel [data-trace]'))throw Error('Generic plotter');window.bazettBase={...document.querySelector('.bazett-svg').dataset};window.bazettQTBody=document.querySelector('[data-bazett-group=qt]').innerHTML;window.bazettOutputBody=document.querySelector('[data-bazett-group=corrected]').innerHTML;return 'Dedicated circular slide rule at 400 ms / 75';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.bazett-svg').dataset;if(Math.abs(Number(d.bazettResult)-559.0169943749474)>1e-5||Number(d.bazettQTAngle)<=Number(window.bazettBase.bazettQTAngle)||Math.abs(Number(d.bazettGainAngle)-Number(window.bazettBase.bazettGainAngle))>1e-5)throw Error('QT sensitivity or rotor changed');if(document.querySelector('[data-bazett-group=qt]').innerHTML===window.bazettQTBody)throw Error('QT arm did not move');if(document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='559')throw Error('Main QT synchronization');return 'QT +100: grey and output arms move; RR rotor stays fixed; QTc 559';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.bazett-svg').dataset;if(Math.abs(Number(d.bazettResult)-565.685424949238)>1e-5||Math.abs(Number(d.bazettQTAngle))>1e-5||Number(d.bazettGainAngle)<=Number(window.bazettBase.bazettGainAngle))throw Error('Rate sensitivity');if(document.querySelector('[data-bazett-group=qt]').innerHTML!==window.bazettQTBody||document.querySelector('[data-bazett-group=corrected]').innerHTML===window.bazettOutputBody)throw Error('Actual arm separation');if(document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='566')throw Error('Main rate synchronization');return 'Rate 120: QT arm stays fixed; rotor and bright arm move; QTc 566';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.bazett-svg').dataset;if(Number(d.bazettGain)!==1||Number(d.bazettRR)!==1||Number(d.bazettQTAngle)!==Number(d.bazettResultAngle)||document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='400')throw Error('60/min identity');return '60/min: RR 1 s, gain 1, pointers align and QTc equals QT';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.bazett-svg').dataset;if(Math.abs(Number(d.bazettResult)-282.842712474619)>1e-5||Number(d.bazettGainAngle)>=0||Number(d.bazettQTAngle)!==0)throw Error('Low rate correction');return '30/min reverses the correction direction at fixed QT';})()

(()=>{if(Number(document.querySelector('#field-heartRate').value.replace(',','.'))<=75)throw Error('Direct heartRate drag failed');if(document.querySelector('#field-heartRate').value!==document.querySelector('#anatomy-heartRate').value)throw Error('Dragged inputs diverged');return 'Direct heartRate knob drag changes shared input';})()

(()=>{if(Number(document.querySelector('#field-qt').value.replace(',','.'))<=400)throw Error('Direct qt drag failed');if(document.querySelector('#field-qt').value!==document.querySelector('#anatomy-qt').value)throw Error('Dragged inputs diverged');return 'Direct qt knob drag changes shared input';})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='—'||document.querySelector('[data-bazett-group=corrected]').style.display!=='none')throw Error('Stale invalid result');return 'Out-of-range QT clears both results and moving hands';})()
(()=>{if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Horizontal overflow');return 'Reset, example and viewport width pass';})()
